organs.Notes: Female FVB, syngeneic A17 mammary tumour, IP 3 mg/kg Q3D four doses starting 10 days after inoculation. Timepoint 24 is the day after tumour inoculation (14 days after treatment start). No conversion to invented numerical severity scores. Author prose says no inflammation in both arms, but Compound 1 table has scarcely present infiltration; retain discrepancy. Reduced nephrotoxicity versus cisplatin does not mean no renal change versus saline. Exact Table 2 symbols: treated +/-; isotonic control -/+; cisplatin +. Symbols retained here and in Author_assessment; numerical value columns left blank because the source scale is not a numerical measurement. Unit (column removed 2026-11-16): ordinal (author scale).
